name: blockwork
description: Records or runs a Blockwork macro directly, in-process, synced to level attempts.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: When off, this mod won't record or run any macro on attempt start/end - level attempts play out completely untouched.

blockwork-dir.name: Blockwork Config Dir Override (Proton only)
blockwork-dir.description: Leave blank on native Windows/macOS. Under Proton, set this to the Wine Z:-mapped path to the Linux Blockwork config dir, e.g. Z:\home\yourname\.config, so this mod reads/writes the same macro files as the desktop app.

action.name: On Level Start
action.description: What to tell Blockwork to do when an attempt starts.

stop-on-end.name: Stop on Attempt End
stop-on-end.description: Send a matching stop command when the attempt ends (death, retry, or completion), so it doesn't bleed into the next attempt.

frame-locked.name: Frame-Locked Playback
frame-locked.description: Run macros on the game's own physics steps instead of wall-clock timing, so every input lands on the exact step it was recorded for. Only affects Run Macro.

substep-clicks.name: Click Between Steps
substep-clicks.description: Developer option: turns on the game's click-between-steps handling during frame-locked playback.

queue-inputs.name: Queue Inputs Like Real Clicks
queue-inputs.description: Developer option: frame-locked inputs go through the game's own input queue instead of being applied directly.

trace-steps.name: Trace Player Positions
trace-steps.description: Developer option: logs the player position on every frame-locked step.

frame-offset.name: Frame-Locked Step Offset
frame-offset.description: Shifts which physics step each macro input lands on (positive = later). The default -1 matches GDR replays, whose frame numbers start at 1. Only for Frame-Locked Playback.

speed-multiplier.name: Speed Multiplier
speed-multiplier.description: Playback speed for the running macro - every Wait duration is divided by this. Combines with the macro's own per-macro speed multiplier (set in the desktop app). 1x is normal speed. Only affects Run Macro; has no effect while recording. Applied at the start of each attempt, so changing it mid-run doesn't retroactively speed up that run.

open-config.name: Open Config Popup
open-config.description: Opens this mod's settings popup. Press again to close it. Works in levels and in menus.

open-macros.name: Open Macros Panel
open-macros.description: Opens a panel to create, rename, delete, and pick which macro is active, and to clear the active macro's recorded instructions. Press again to close it. Works in levels and in menus.
